noteDialog.message: Add a note so the next admin knows what was done. A resolved exception reopens if a later sync reports it again; a dismissed one stays dismissed.

MISSING_PATIENT_ID.title: Patient without an id
MISSING_PATIENT_ID.happened: An HHAeXchange patient record had no patient id, so it was skipped.
MISSING_PATIENT_ID.action: Report the record to HHAeXchange support.

MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD.title: Required field missing
MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD.happened: A required field (such as first or last name) was empty, so the record was skipped.

UNMAPPED_STATUS_ID.title: Unknown patient status
UNMAPPED_STATUS_ID.happened: HHAeXchange sent a status PreventaTri does not know. The patient was imported as Active.
UNMAPPED_STATUS_ID.action: Check the status in HHAeXchange; ask dev to map the new value.

UNMAPPED_GENDER.title: Unknown gender
UNMAPPED_GENDER.happened: HHAeXchange sent a gender value PreventaTri does not know. The patient was imported without a gender.

ARCHIVED_PATIENT_UPDATED.title: Archived patient changed
ARCHIVED_PATIENT_UPDATED.happened: An archived patient changed in HHAeXchange. It was updated and stays archived.
ARCHIVED_PATIENT_UPDATED.action: Decide whether the patient should be active again.

UPSERT_FAILED.title: Save failed
UPSERT_FAILED.happened: A database write failed, so this record was left unchanged.
UPSERT_FAILED.action: Run the sync again; if it repeats, report it to dev.

MISSING_COUNTY_ZIP.title: No ZIP code
MISSING_COUNTY_ZIP.happened: The patient has no ZIP code in HHAeXchange, so no county could be set.
MISSING_COUNTY_ZIP.action: Add the ZIP in HHAeXchange; the next sync clears this and sets the county if this organization has it. To route the patient sooner, set the county on the patient here. Until then, if the patient has no county, its flags go straight to the admin.

UNRESOLVED_COUNTY_ZIP.title: ZIP not recognized
UNRESOLVED_COUNTY_ZIP.happened: The ZIP code from HHAeXchange is not in the US ZIP-to-county table, or it is split between counties, so the county was left as is.
UNRESOLVED_COUNTY_ZIP.action: Check the ZIP in HHAeXchange and correct it; the next sync clears this. If the ZIP is right (a PO box, or a ZIP split between counties), set the county on the patient here and dismiss this. Until then, if the patient has no county, its flags go straight to the admin.

COUNTY_NOT_IN_ORGANIZATION.title: County not set up
COUNTY_NOT_IN_ORGANIZATION.happened: The ZIP is valid, but it resolves to a county this organization does not have yet, so the county was left as is.
COUNTY_NOT_IN_ORGANIZATION.action: Add the county to a region here; nothing needs changing in HHAeXchange. Or set another county on the patient and dismiss this. Until then, if the patient has no county, its flags go straight to the admin.

ZIP_STATE_MISMATCH.title: State and ZIP do not match
ZIP_STATE_MISMATCH.happened: The ZIP code belongs to a different state than the one on the address, so the county was left as is.
ZIP_STATE_MISMATCH.action: Correct the state or ZIP in HHAeXchange; the next sync clears this. To route the patient sooner, set the county on the patient here. Until then, if the patient has no county, its flags go straight to the admin.

OUT_OF_STATE_ZIP.title: Address in another state
OUT_OF_STATE_ZIP.happened: An earlier sync only placed ZIP codes in one state, so this address got no county. ZIP codes now resolve in every state.
OUT_OF_STATE_ZIP.action: Run a sync; it closes this. If it stays open after a sync, HHAeXchange no longer sends this patient, so dismiss it.

PATIENT_NURSE_ELEMENT_MISSING.title: Nurse field missing from feed
PATIENT_NURSE_ELEMENT_MISSING.happened: HHAeXchange stopped sending the nurse on a whole page, so every nurse link was kept.
PATIENT_NURSE_ELEMENT_MISSING.action: Report to dev: the HHAeXchange feed changed.

PATIENT_COORDINATOR_ELEMENT_MISSING.title: Coordinator field missing from feed
PATIENT_COORDINATOR_ELEMENT_MISSING.happened: HHAeXchange stopped sending coordinators on a whole page, so every case manager link was kept.
PATIENT_COORDINATOR_ELEMENT_MISSING.action: Report to dev: the HHAeXchange feed changed.

UNKNOWN_HHA_NURSE.title: Unknown nurse
UNKNOWN_HHA_NURSE.happened: HHAeXchange assigns a nurse who is not in PreventaTri. The current primary nurse was kept.
UNKNOWN_HHA_NURSE.action: Sync nurses, or reassign the nurse in HHAeXchange. Until then an admin can pick a primary nurse on the patient; this exception stays open while HHAeXchange names the missing nurse.

NO_HHA_COORDINATOR.title: No coordinator
NO_HHA_COORDINATOR.happened: HHAeXchange lists no coordinator for this patient. The current case manager was kept.

UNKNOWN_COORDINATOR_NAME.title: Unknown coordinator
UNKNOWN_COORDINATOR_NAME.happened: The coordinator name matches no case manager here. The current case manager was kept.
UNKNOWN_COORDINATOR_NAME.action: Sync case managers, or fix the name in HHAeXchange.

AMBIGUOUS_COORDINATOR_NAME.title: Two case managers share the name
AMBIGUOUS_COORDINATOR_NAME.happened: Two case managers have this coordinator's name and the id lookup failed. The current case manager was kept.
AMBIGUOUS_COORDINATOR_NAME.action: Rename one of them in HHAeXchange.

CASE_MANAGER_ARCHIVED.title: Case manager archived
CASE_MANAGER_ARCHIVED.happened: The coordinator in HHAeXchange is archived here. The current case manager was kept.

PRIMARY_NURSE_CONFLICT.title: Primary nurse differs from HHAeXchange
PRIMARY_NURSE_CONFLICT.happened: HHAeXchange now assigns a nurse to this patient, but an admin already picked a different primary nurse here. The PreventaTri nurse was kept.
PRIMARY_NURSE_CONFLICT.action: Choose which nurse stays: keep the PreventaTri nurse, or use the HHAeXchange nurse.

CASE_MANAGER_CONFLICT.title: Case manager differs from HHAeXchange
CASE_MANAGER_CONFLICT.happened: HHAeXchange's case manager for this patient is active now, but someone else was put on the patient while they were not. The current case manager was kept.
CASE_MANAGER_CONFLICT.action: Choose who stays: keep the current case manager, or use the HHAeXchange case manager.

NURSE_INVITATION_PENDING.title: Nurse has not accepted an invitation
NURSE_INVITATION_PENDING.happened: HHAeXchange assigns this nurse to patients, but the nurse has not accepted an invitation to PreventaTri yet, so those patients were not given to them.
NURSE_INVITATION_PENDING.action: Invite the nurse. They get their patients the moment they accept. Until then you can pick another primary nurse on each patient.

CASE_MANAGER_INVITATION_PENDING.title: Case manager has not accepted an invitation
CASE_MANAGER_INVITATION_PENDING.happened: HHAeXchange names this case manager on patients, but they have not accepted an invitation to PreventaTri yet, so those patients were not given to them.
CASE_MANAGER_INVITATION_PENDING.action: Invite the case manager. They get their patients the moment they accept. Until then you can pick another case manager on each patient.

NURSE_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Nurse is not active
NURSE_NOT_ACTIVE.happened: HHAeXchange assigns this nurse to patients, but the nurse is inactive or archived here, so they were taken off those patients.
NURSE_NOT_ACTIVE.action: Reactivate the nurse or reassign the patients in HHAeXchange. Until then you can pick another primary nurse on each patient.

CASE_MANAGER_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Case manager is not active
CASE_MANAGER_NOT_ACTIVE.happened: HHAeXchange names this case manager on patients, but they are inactive or archived here, so they were taken off those patients.
CASE_MANAGER_NOT_ACTIVE.action: Reactivate the case manager or reassign the patients in HHAeXchange. Until then you can pick another case manager on each patient.

SELECTED_COORDINATOR_REMOVED.title: Chosen coordinator removed
SELECTED_COORDINATOR_REMOVED.happened: The coordinator an admin chose as case manager is no longer on this patient in HHAeXchange, or is archived here. The sync went back to HHAeXchange's first coordinator.
SELECTED_COORDINATOR_REMOVED.action: Choose the case manager again on the Coordinators tab.

SECONDARY_NURSE_MATCHES_PRIMARY.title: Secondary nurse became primary
SECONDARY_NURSE_MATCHES_PRIMARY.happened: HHAeXchange made the secondary nurse the primary nurse, so the secondary nurse was cleared.
SECONDARY_NURSE_MATCHES_PRIMARY.action: Pick another secondary nurse for the patient.

SECONDARY_NURSE_REGION_MISMATCH.title: Secondary nurse outside region
SECONDARY_NURSE_REGION_MISMATCH.happened: The patient moved to a county the secondary nurse does not cover, so the secondary nurse was cleared.
SECONDARY_NURSE_REGION_MISMATCH.action: Pick a secondary nurse for the new region.

LINK_LOOKUP_FAILED.title: Lookup failed
LINK_LOOKUP_FAILED.happened: Nurses, case managers or patients could not be read for linking, so links were kept for this run.

MISSING_CAREGIVER_ID.title: Caregiver without an id
MISSING_CAREGIVER_ID.happened: An HHAeXchange caregiver record had no id, so it was skipped.
MISSING_CAREGIVER_ID.action: Report the record to HHAeXchange support.

MISSING_DISCIPLINE.title: No discipline
MISSING_DISCIPLINE.happened: The caregiver has no discipline in HHAeXchange and was imported with role Unspecified.

UNMAPPED_CAREGIVER_STATUS.title: Unknown caregiver status
UNMAPPED_CAREGIVER_STATUS.happened: HHAeXchange sent a status PreventaTri does not know. The caregiver was imported as Active.
UNMAPPED_CAREGIVER_STATUS.action: Check the status in HHAeXchange; ask dev to map it.

UNMAPPED_LANGUAGE.title: Unknown language
UNMAPPED_LANGUAGE.happened: HHAeXchange sent a language PreventaTri does not know. The caregiver was imported without a language.

ARCHIVED_CAREGIVER_UPDATED.title: Archived caregiver changed
ARCHIVED_CAREGIVER_UPDATED.happened: An archived caregiver changed in HHAeXchange. They were updated and stay archived.
ARCHIVED_CAREGIVER_UPDATED.action: Decide whether they should be active again.

MISSING_COORDINATOR_ID.title: Coordinator without an id
MISSING_COORDINATOR_ID.happened: An HHAeXchange coordinator record had no id, so it was skipped.
MISSING_COORDINATOR_ID.action: Report the record to HHAeXchange support.

UNMAPPED_COORDINATOR_STATUS.title: Unknown case manager status
UNMAPPED_COORDINATOR_STATUS.happened: HHAeXchange sent a status PreventaTri does not know. The case manager was imported as Active.
UNMAPPED_COORDINATOR_STATUS.action: Check the status in HHAeXchange; ask dev to map it.

ARCHIVED_CASE_MANAGER_UPDATED.title: Archived case manager changed
ARCHIVED_CASE_MANAGER_UPDATED.happened: An archived case manager changed in HHAeXchange. They were updated and stay archived.
ARCHIVED_CASE_MANAGER_UPDATED.action: Decide whether they should be active again.

UNMAPPED_PROFESSIONAL_ROLE.title: Unknown nurse discipline
UNMAPPED_PROFESSIONAL_ROLE.happened: The nurse's discipline is not RN or LPN, so they were imported as RN.

UNMAPPED_NURSE_STATUS.title: Unknown nurse status
UNMAPPED_NURSE_STATUS.happened: HHAeXchange sent a status PreventaTri does not know. The nurse was imported as Active.
UNMAPPED_NURSE_STATUS.action: Check the status in HHAeXchange; ask dev to map it.

INVALID_NPI.title: Invalid NPI
INVALID_NPI.happened: The NPI is not 10 digits, so it was stored empty.

ARCHIVED_NURSE_UPDATED.title: Archived nurse changed
ARCHIVED_NURSE_UPDATED.happened: An archived nurse changed in HHAeXchange. They were updated and stay archived.
ARCHIVED_NURSE_UPDATED.action: Decide whether they should be active again.

NURSE_DEMOGRAPHICS_UNAVAILABLE.title: Nurse details unavailable
NURSE_DEMOGRAPHICS_UNAVAILABLE.happened: A roster nurse's details could not be read, so the nurse was not created or refreshed.
NURSE_DEMOGRAPHICS_UNAVAILABLE.action: Run the sync again; if it repeats, report it to HHAeXchange.

NURSE_ROSTER_UNAVAILABLE.title: Nurse roster unavailable
NURSE_ROSTER_UNAVAILABLE.happened: The nurse roster could not be read, so the caregiver import stopped for this run.

CAREGIVER_RECLASSIFIED_AS_NURSE.title: Caregiver converted to nurse
CAREGIVER_RECLASSIFIED_AS_NURSE.happened: A nurse imported earlier as a caregiver was converted into a nurse.
CAREGIVER_RECLASSIFIED_AS_NURSE.action: Nothing to do; this is for information.

DUPLICATE_EMAIL.title: Email already in use
DUPLICATE_EMAIL.happened: HHAeXchange gives this person the same email as another user here. PreventaTri needs a unique login email for each person, so they were not imported.
DUPLICATE_EMAIL.action: Give the person their own login email on the Shared emails tab; HHAeXchange can keep the shared one. They are imported as soon as you save it.

EMAIL_IN_USE.title: New email already in use
EMAIL_IN_USE.happened: HHAeXchange changed this person's email to one another user here already has. PreventaTri needs a unique login email for each person, so the old email was kept.
EMAIL_IN_USE.action: Give them their own login email on the Shared emails tab, or keep the old one and dismiss this.

HHA_EMAIL_CHANGED.title: Email changed in HHAeXchange
HHA_EMAIL_CHANGED.happened: HHAeXchange changed this person's email, but an admin set their login email here, so the login email was kept. The detail shows the old and new HHAeXchange email.
HHA_EMAIL_CHANGED.action: Check whether the login email should change too. If so, update it on the person's record or the Shared emails tab; otherwise resolve this.

INVALID_EMAIL.title: Invalid email
INVALID_EMAIL.happened: HHAeXchange's email is not a valid address. The old email was kept.

MISSING_VISIT_ID.title: Visit without an id
MISSING_VISIT_ID.happened: An HHAeXchange visit had no id, so it was skipped.
MISSING_VISIT_ID.action: Report the visit to HHAeXchange support.

UNMAPPED_MISSED_REASON.title: Unknown missed-visit reason
UNMAPPED_MISSED_REASON.happened: HHAeXchange sent a missed-visit reason PreventaTri does not know. It was stored without a reason.

UNMAPPED_MISSED_VISIT.title: Unknown missed-visit value
UNMAPPED_MISSED_VISIT.happened: HHAeXchange sent a missed-visit value PreventaTri does not know.

UNMAPPED_TIMEZONE.title: Unknown time zone
UNMAPPED_TIMEZONE.happened: HHAeXchange sent a time zone PreventaTri does not know. The default zone was used.
